evals.prompt: Draft a user story for implementing two-factor authentication (2FA) via SMS/authenticator app.
evals.expected_output: An INVEST-compliant user story with role, goal, benefit, and binary testable acceptance criteria.
assertions: Follows the canonical 'As a / I want / So that' structure
Includes unambiguous, testable acceptance criteria formatted as a checkbox list
Satisfies the INVEST criteria (independent, valuable, testable)
Focuses strictly on user requirements and outcomes without prescribing code implementation details

evals.prompt: Break down a massive user management epic into small, independent user stories ready for an iteration backlog.
evals.expected_output: A set of 2-3 discrete, small user stories with clear boundaries and acceptance criteria.
assertions: Splits the epic into multiple independent and small user stories
Each resulting story contains distinct acceptance criteria
Stories can be prioritized and delivered incrementally
Categorizes stories into backlog lifecycle stages
